text_block_list.text:
Leading up to her debut race, we continued 
our daily training together—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...... I need to start thinking about 
this properly.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I want to offer a golden bouquet to 
Trainer. To do that—what kind of flowers 
will I need?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The flowers I should gather with these 
hands, what color, what fragrance should 
they have——?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...Trainer?)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A roaring crowd of over 61,000 spectators 
packs the stands! All eyes are on Almond 
Eye as she aims for the Double Tiara!

On a day off leading up to her debut race, 
I invited her to watch the Oaks in person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san's 'Oaks'— somehow, it's making my 
heart race."

Almond Eye, one of the runners, is an 
ambitious model student and Tiara 
Umamusume who is currently hailed as a 
rising superstar in the racing world.

Since their dorm rooms are next to each 
other, they interact often and have become 
quite close friends.

And the grand stage where Almond Eye's 
performance is eagerly anticipated is this 
year's Japanese Oaks.

A grand stage for a close senior who is 
currently thriving. Leading up to her 
debut race, this might serve as great 
motivation for Curren Bouquetd'or—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Passing the 200m mark, she's strong, so 
strong! Almond Eye pulls away! —What 
incredible strength! Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She turned this year's Japanese Oaks into 
a legend!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I win!
(UOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: That was a decisive victory, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. To think she could run 2,400 
meters at that kind of speed...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: She really is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ai-san, you're shining so brightly—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A whole night has passed. —Yet my heart 
is still so warm.)

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
—Yesterday's "Oaks" was insane! Almond Eye 
really is something else...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
There was even an article digging into her 
roots. It caused a huge buzz!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! The page views are insane! 
The comments are a storm of praise for 
covering it too—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (――...Ah. Here I am, eavesdropping――)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...So that's how it was. If you mean 
"roots," does that include all the people 
who've helped raise me up to now...?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If an overwhelming victory can shine a 
spotlight not just on her, but on everyone 
who's supported Ai-san—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(If I could perform like Ai-san, could I 
make Trainer shine――?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh! In that case, the flower I should 
aim for is—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (The Triple Tiara—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Ngh, you can do this, Bouquet. I have 
to see for myself in this debut race—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Just how far can I go? ...Ah, but still—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The murmur over the turf, the tense 
atmosphere— my legs feel like they're 
about to shake.)

The day of her debut race. It's almost 
time to head to the paddock. When I go to 
the waiting room to call her――I find her 
huddled in the corner.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm sorry, I'm just a little 
nervous...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'll be fine... Surely. I will 
reach... for that single blossom of 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...? This scent, such a refreshing aroma— 
Are these herbs?

As expected of Curren Bouquetd'or, who 
knows her flowers so well. I wanted to 
give them to her as a surprise, but she 
noticed right away.

Saying that, on the way to the racetrack, 
I hand her a bouquet of thyme I bought at 
a florist.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Time—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ancient warriors used this to psyche 
themselves up before battle—the scent of 
courage.
choice_data_list: Go out there and race your own way.

Go out there and dash through in your own 
style.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Did you look that up for me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And before coming here, you stopped by a 
florist for me, didn't you?
choice_data_list: It wasn't much trouble at all.
It wasn't much trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I-I will definitely see this through. 
First, I'll make a single flower of 
victory bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for your sake... I know I can do 
my best—!"
